posts.title: Road to Fantasy Basketball Draft Part 3 - Early Preseason Looks
posts.description: The week is finally here! This weekend is the draft for my fantasy basketball league, and I am excited. The NBA season starts next week as well so I am ready to sit back and enjoy the games. Currently though, it is preseason in the NBA. Preseason numbers are a glimpse but I wouldn't call it a definitive outlook on how a player will do this season. This is where the coaches play rookies to get them
